interest and dividends: final withholding tax (no further tax), rates not read; excluded
pensions and capital gains (Capital Gains Tax Act) not modelled
pension contribution applied to total wages (PRA 'monthly emoluments' = basic + housing + transport)
minimum tax (Sixth Schedule: 1 per cent of 'Gross Income') read on the s. 33 (2) gross income (net of the tax-exempt pension contribution), as the consolidated relief allowance in the same sentence

taxes.statute: CITA Cap. C21 s. 40 as substituted by Finance Act 2019 s. 16 (small company: exempt under s. 23 (1) (o); medium-sized company 20 kobo per naira; large company 30 kobo per naira), s. 105 definitions (small: gross turnover N25,000,000 or less; medium: greater than N25,000,000 but less than N100,000,000); minimum tax s. 33 (2) as substituted by Finance Act 2021 s. 10 (0,5 % of gross turnover less franked investment income; 0,25 % only for 2020-2021) and s. 33 (3) (b) (Finance Act 2019 s. 14: not applicable below N25,000,000)
taxes.tax: Companies income tax (medium-sized company: 20 kobo per naira)

taxes.statute: Tertiary Education Trust Fund (Establishment, etc.) Act 2011 s. 1 (2) as substituted by the Finance Act 2020 s. 34 and amended by the Finance Act 2023 s. 26 (2,5 % -> 3 %); held ng/law/finance_act_ocr.txt, finance_act_2023_ocr.txt
taxes.tax: Tertiary education tax (3 % of assessable profit)

taxes.statute: Industrial Training Fund (Amendment) Act 2011 s. 6 (1): 1 % of the total annual payroll of an employer with fewer than five employees and a turnover of N50 m or more a year
taxes.tax: Industrial Training Fund contribution (1 % of total annual payroll)

taxes.statute: Employees' Compensation Act 2010 (No. 13) s. 33 (1)-(2) (gazette copy on nsitf.gov.ng via Wayback, R4/fetch/ng11) [text version: Employees' Compensation Act 2010 (No. 13) as gazetted]
taxes.tax: Employees' Compensation Fund (NSITF), employer contribution (1 % of monthly payroll)

unsupported: Finance Act 2022 not held (flagged); the 2025 rates rest on FA 2019 (s. 40), FA 2021 (s. 33) and FA 2023 (no change to s. 23, 33 or 40)

franked investment income is not deducted from the minimum-tax base; the four-year start-up exclusion and the other s. 33 (3) exclusions are not modelled; tertiary education tax (3 %) and other levies on profits are separate taxes, not modelled here

services: the Schedule's consultancy / technical / management / professional fees line (10 %) is applied to every service payment abroad; 'supply or rendering of services other than those specifically listed' is 5 % (not distinguished)
fourteenth pass: 2024 Regulations (gazetted, effective 1 January 2025) replace the 2015 FIRS notice; services to non-resident individuals 5 % -> 10 %

2200 National Health Insurance Authority contribution (employer): not modelled (the Act does not print the rates; the official download of the Operational Guidelines 2023 (nhia.gov.ng, R4/fetch/p14/ng_nhia_og2023.pdf, OCR'd) holds only the front matter and table of contents (22 pages), not section 2.2.4 'Financing mechanism for contributory schemes')
